# Call Pro AI

> Call Pro AI is a free calling CRM for Indian real-estate teams. Telecallers call leads from an Android app with an auto-dialer, and the owner sees calls, follow-ups, site visits and bookings on a web dashboard. Free to use, no card, no trial period.

Made for builders, developers and brokers in India with telecaller teams. Telecaller app: Android. Owner dashboard: any browser. Contact: admin@callproai.in.

## Key pages

- [About Call Pro AI](https://callproai.in/about): key facts, features, who it is for, limits and FAQ
- [Home](https://callproai.in/): product overview
- [Create a free account](https://callproai.in/signup): sign up with Google or email
- [Privacy policy](https://callproai.in/privacy)

## Features

- Android auto-dialer on the telecaller's own SIM, working through the Call now list
- Lead buckets: Call now, Scheduled, Win back
- Follow Ups grouped as Overdue, Today and Upcoming
- Call recording (where the phone allows) with an AI summary and coaching tip
- Facebook and Instagram lead-form sync; site visits and bookings sent back to Meta
- Scan list: photo of a printed list becomes leads, read on the phone
- Attendance check-in and GPS-verified site visits
- WhatsApp templates and one-tap WhatsApp
- Owner dashboard and a daily evening report
